Messages.Body:
In article <aKlL5.343$5w6.2...@news.uswest.net>,

"Xian" <xi...@waste.org> wrote:
> Waiting anxiously for the release tomorrow, I was thinking
> about Lucita. Apologies if this was discussed immediately
> after her release...
>
> Aside from the Independent text, Lucita still *is* a Lasombra for
> cards like Power Structure, etc., correct?

Yes. Her clan is Lasombra.
Her sect is Independent.
If she is in play, you may play an Elysian Fields,
Political Hunting Ground, Political Seizure, Political
Struggle.

She will not get the bonus from the Hungry Coyote, Festivo
Dello Estinto, or Communal Haven: Temple.

Carpe Noctem.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Mon, 30 Oct 2000, Xian wrote:

> Aside from the Independent text, Lucita still *is* a Lasombra for cards like
> Power Structure, etc., correct?
>
> Guessing yes, but I just thought I'd ask.

Lucita = Lasombra
Lucita also = Independent

If something requires Lasombra, or affects Lasombra, she is. IF something
affects Independent, non-Sabbat or non-Camarilla, she is that too.
